resolution: Fixed in WF03-GH814-20260817: (1) backfill_batch_size parameter added to recordBatchProgress — adaptive value now persisted instead of hardcoded 5000; (2) recordTerminalStatus call added after loop exit to write applied/failed status; (3) TC-DDL-04-AC6b test added asserting terminal status and adaptive batch_size in plat_migration_state. Commits 9387094c and 07a7deab on branch feature/WF03-GH814-20260817.
title: DDL-04: plat_migration_state bookkeeping - backfill_batch_size column hardcoded 5000, persisted status stays running after completion
summary: recordBatchProgress hardcodes backfill_batch_size=5000 in the persisted row (adaptive value only in BackfillResult.final_batch_size) and leaves persisted status running after loop completion (design applied/failed terminal write missing). Non-blocking; documented and asserted in tests.
description: src/platform/backfill.zig progress INSERT hardcodes 5000 (line ~379) and progress UPDATE sets status running (line ~383). TC-DDL-04-AC6 explicitly documents and asserts the running status while asserting in-memory BackfillResult.status applied/failed. AC4 adaptive halving proven via final_batch_size (asserted 2500); AC6 progress counters recorded. No AC violated.
symptom: plat_migration_state.backfill_batch_size never reflects the adaptive value; completed backfills remain status running in the persisted row.
investigation_notes: Documented in tests/integration/ddl04_backfill_loop_test.zig TC-DDL-04-AC6 NOTE comment and tests/specs/DDL-04.md Run status. New issue (gh search found no pre-existing).
reproduction: Run a DDL-04 backfill to completion; read plat_migration_state - backfill_batch_size=5000 regardless of adaptive halving and status=running.
acceptance_criteria: Persisted plat_migration_state row reflects terminal status (applied/failed) and adaptive backfill_batch_size at loop end, OR the divergence is documented as an intentional design choice
No DDL-04 AC regression (suites stay green)

defect_1_hardcoded_batch_size.description: INSERT VALUES literal 5000 used for backfill_batch_size column; the adaptive batch_size variable is never passed to recordBatchProgress, so the persisted row always shows the initial default regardless of adaptive halving.

defect_2_missing_terminal_status_write.description: recordBatchProgress always sets status = 'running' in both INSERT and ON CONFLICT UPDATE (line 383). runBackfill returns BackfillResult (line 329) with status .applied or .failed but never calls any persistence function after the loop; plat_migration_state is left with status running permanently.

test_documentation.note: Test explicitly documents the divergence with a NOTE comment and asserts status='running'; must be updated to assert 'applied' after the fix.

recommended_fix: 1. Add batch_size as $9 parameter to recordBatchProgress; replace literal 5000 on line 379 with $9 parameter; add backfill_batch_size = EXCLUDED.backfill_batch_size to the ON CONFLICT UPDATE SET clause (remove status = 'running' from UPDATE; keep initial INSERT status as 'running').

2. After the loop exits (before line 329 return), call a new persistence function (e.g. recordTerminalStatus) that executes UPDATE plat_migration_state SET status = $4, backfill_batch_size = $5, updated_at = now() WHERE migration_id = $1 AND tenant_schema = $2 AND phase = $3; pass 'applied' or 'failed' based on the stalled flag.
3. Update TC-DDL-04-AC6 in ddl04_backfill_loop_test.zig: remove NOTE comment, change expectEqualStrings('running', ...) to expectEqualStrings('applied', ...).
